pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Warm-season:$() sow after the last frost, into warm soil. Sprouts after 50 °C·d above 10 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)950 °C·d$(). Best near 25 °C; stops above 35 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -0.5 °C (0 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6-7 (tolerates 5.3-7.8). Roots 0.9 m. Dislikes waterlogging.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 120, P 15, K 80 kg/ha per crop; fixes about 40% of its own nitrogen.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 18 cwt/ac (2 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Dry Beans.
